title: Two defaults
prompt: Both parameters have defaults: width is 4 and height is 3 unless the caller says otherwise. Return width times height.
signature: func solve(width: int = 4, height: int = 3) -> int:
starter:
func solve(width: int = 4, height: int = 3) -> int:
	return 0
hint: With one value passed, only the first parameter changes; the second keeps its default.
solution:
func solve(width: int = 4, height: int = 3) -> int:
	return width * height
